notes.title: FreeCell Quest Tabletop Fest
notes.content:
Play with the Developer Livestream!

FreeCell Quest is an RPG FreeCell game. You’ve never played FreeCell like this before!

When an archmage takes control of the entire continent of Selvarin, the world’s most powerful wizards try and fail to defeat him in battle. You are a young wizard, a master of cards, and you may have what it takes to outwit him.

The better you play, the stronger you become. Get heroic loot and collect cards to unlock new free cells. Level up to become more powerful and gain amazing skills. Travel across a vast and mysterious land, playing game after game as you prepare for your final battle.

notes.title: New Themes Available
notes.content:
Today we added a new build of FreeCell Quest that has some new cosmetic steam inventory items that are fully tradeable and marketable on steam.

Here's the new theme selection screen:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6DBV07l.png[/img]

And here's how they look when being used:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Rs8iqvz.png[/img]

Also updated to the latest version of Unity, which caused lots of bugs which needed fixing, but should now have improved performance on load times and such.

Thank you all for your support! :_hearts: :_hearts: :_hearts: :_hearts:
 
[h1]Full Change Log[/h1]

Card face selection mostly working.
Added most clean card faces.
Finished clean card exports from inkscape.
Finished card face graphics work.
Fixed card dragging sort order.
Improved victory screen cosmetics.
Switched text spinner to use floating point numbers instead of integers.
Finished designing card faces.
Theme chooser has correct faces displayed and sized.
Save selected card face to player settings.
Fixed crash on certain spells because of the new card rendering changes.
Fixed card theme selection interface.
Load Steam Inventory on overworld load. 
Made SteamInventoryManager never get destroyed.
Fixed crash/delay after fight scene.
Fixed transitions
Added splash screen
Polished buy interface.
Polished transitions.
Added steam kill check.
Removed splash screen.
Updated steam item names and icons.
Fixed missing save game issue.
Fixed transition screens when alt-tabbing while a transition is in progress.
Fixed pause menu crash.

notes.title: Today's Changes
notes.content:
New Sailing Interface. Lines are shown on map to clickable sailing destinations and the really terrible old menu removed. Sail destinations should be clear now.
Cut sail cost by 95%
Cut rest cost by 50%
Upped death penalty to 20% of gold.
Fix level achievements not awarding on the right level.
Make Fizzle spell enabled only when an attack is pending.
Update draggable stacks after casting Summon to get another Free Cell.
Reduced cast times on healing spells to zero.
Increase double click threshold from 0.3 seconds to 0.5 seconds.
Made all the attack glow colors black to make it even more clear and ominous.

notes.title: FreeCell Quest Released!
notes.content:
Hello,

I'm Bryan Livingston and my latest game FreeCell Quest is released on Monday, October 19th,

There's thousands of FreeCell games but they all feature the exact same game play. With this game I wanted to take the addicting game play of FreeCell and innovate. So I took it and made it into an RPG, complete with combat, spells, leveling and a gigantic beautifully rendered map to explore. This game is NOT ANYTHING LIKE the Fairway Solitaire type of games.

I know it's not an ideal fit for most of the Steam user base, but lets try to get some more diversity of games and players on there. It's probably not going to ever turn a profit but I just had to make it because this unholy combination is just too good to pass up.

The mobile FreeCell Quest version has been very well received with a 4.7 star review average! With the Steam release we moved away from the free-to-play limited and ad supported shareware model used on the mobile version, since it's just not a good fit for steam. The $4.99 price seems like an fair and honest deal considering the hundreds of hours a typical Free Cell addict can spend playing the game. Please grab it while there's the 15% launch discount sale.

Top priorities going forward are [b]adding side quests and a nicer tutorial[/b] to the game. Please take a quick moment to fill out the feedback survey at https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1PnqqtzXaus9q0eAydxYlWmhqvouh4JpuoxBD3Rodgjw/viewform to help me prioritize. Also please give it a thumb up if you like the game as future updates depend on our rating and sales.

You can download our press kit that contains screenshots, key art, etc. at http://mob0.com/FreeCell%20Quest%20Press%20Kit.zip

I'm happily available for any interviews, Q&As, postmortems, play with devs, podcast, streaming, BBQing or bar hopping that you'd like to do. Ask me anything!

Thank you for your consideration!

Bryan Livingston
Lead Programmer and Founder
http://legendstudio.com

notes.title: Release and Launch Day Patch
notes.content:
We'll should be releasing the game later this afternoon. ːsteamhappyː

My top priorities going forward are adding side quests and a nicer tutorial to the game.

Here's a list of changes for the last minute updates we're doing.

[b]Changes[/b]
Fixed Main Menu Crash Relating to Background Map (This error was reported by our fancy error reporting system and while we've not been able to reproduce it directly, we're pretty sure it's fixed. Maybe caused by multi-touching while launching.)
Fixed camera scrolling off map on menu screen. (Collider size was incorrect)
Fixed Linux and Mac Builds (Zero files were getting deployed.)
New Class System
Pick a class at character create. (WIll be adding a Potion of Class Changing soon)
See: http://mob0.com/FreeCell-Quest/CharacterSelect.png
Class avatars shown in overworld.
Each class has a bonus and a penalty.
